# idsec_sia_k8s_generate_cluster_config (Resource)

The SIA K8s generate cluster config resource, generates a kubeconfig file for a specific set of K8s clusters and access reasons.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `clusters_file` (String) Path to a JSON file containing the clusters to include in the generated kubeconfig, in the format returned by list-clusters. Add a reason when isReasonRequired is set to true.
- `folder` (String) The output folder in which the kubeconfig is written.
- `reason_to_all` (String) If set, use this reason for every cluster, ignoring any per-cluster reason values in the JSON clusters file.

### Read-Only

- `kubeconfig_path` (String) Full path to the generated kubeconfig file.
